taxonomy_context.source_of_truth_principle: transactions is source of truth; state and aggregates are derived layers

taxonomy_metric_coverage.strategy: Flat catalog. Full north star active set (62 KPIs). No tiers. Matcher priority handled by deliberate aliases and per-cluster default-resolution.

revenue_cluster.note: Bare 'revenue' always resolves to total_token_revenue. Aliases are non-overlapping across members.

kpis.name: Total Token Revenue
kpis.business_definition: Total USDC value of completed transactions, platform-wide. Group by token_id for per-token revenue. This is the same number sometimes called GTV; it is revenue, not a trade count or quantity.
example_questions: What is total token revenue this month?
How much revenue did we make?
Total sales revenue last week
How much revenue did token X generate?
Show me GTV by day
quality_notes: Status is lowercase 'completed' — never 'COMPLETED'. Filter: lower(status) = 'completed'.
Equals SUM(tokens.total_revenue) by construction.
'volume' is NOT an alias of this metric.

kpis.name: Total Transactions
kpis.business_definition: Count of completed transactions platform-wide.
example_questions: How many transactions were completed this month?
Total number of trades this week
Transaction count by day
quality_notes: Status lowercase: lower(status) = 'completed'.

kpis.name: Average Transaction Size (USDC)
kpis.business_definition: Average USDC value per completed transaction.
example_questions: What is the average transaction size in USDC?
Average trade value this month
Mean transaction amount
quality_notes: Filter: lower(status) = 'completed'.

kpis.name: Average Token Price
kpis.business_definition: Average current_price across all tokens. current_price is a bonding-curve function of total_sold, not an independent market price.
example_questions: What is the average token price across the platform?
Average price of all tokens
Mean token price by issuer type
quality_notes: current_price is bonding-curve derived, not a market price.

kpis.name: Token Price Growth Rate
kpis.business_definition: Price change per token over a window, derived from ending_price ordered by timestamp. Powers top-gainers view. No price-history table — reconstruct from transactions.

sql_recipe.raw_sql: WITH ordered AS (SELECT token_id, ending_price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY token_id ORDER BY timestamp ASC) AS rn_first, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY token_id ORDER BY timestamp DESC) AS rn_last FROM transactions WHERE lower(status)='completed') SELECT f.token_id, f.ending_price AS start_price, l.ending_price AS end_price, (l.ending_price - f.ending_price) / NULLIF(f.ending_price, 0) AS price_growth_rate FROM ordered f JOIN ordered l ON f.token_id = l.token_id WHERE f.rn_first = 1 AND l.rn_last = 1

example_questions: Which tokens have gained the most in price this week?
Top token price gainers
Price change rate per token
Token price growth
quality_notes: No price-history table — reconstruct from transactions.ending_price ordered by timestamp.
Filter: lower(status) = 'completed'.

kpis.name: Active Tradable Tokens
kpis.business_definition: Tokens with paused_sales = false and at least one completed transaction.
example_questions: How many tokens are actively tradable?
Count of live tokens with sales
Active tokens on the platform
quality_notes: Must join tokens to transactions and filter paused_sales = false AND lower(status) = 'completed'.

kpis.name: Tokens With No Trading Activity
kpis.business_definition: Tokens with zero completed transactions.
kpis.multi_table_rationale: Anti-join: tokens LEFT JOIN completed transactions, filter WHERE transaction is NULL.

sql_recipe.raw_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.token_id) AS tokens_with_no_activity FROM tokens t LEFT JOIN transactions tx ON t.token_id = tx.token_id AND lower(tx.status)='completed' WHERE tx.transaction_id IS NULL

example_questions: How many tokens have never been traded?
Tokens with zero sales
Inactive tokens with no transactions
quality_notes: Anti-join on completed transactions.

kpis.name: Total Market Capitalization
kpis.business_definition: SUM(current_price x total_sold) across all tokens. Circulating supply = total_sold (never current_supply_minted which is always 0).
example_questions: What is the total market cap of all tokens?
Platform market capitalization
Total value of all tokens in circulation
quality_notes: Use total_sold as circulating supply — current_supply_minted is always 0 in current data.
current_price is bonding-curve derived, not a market price.

kpis.name: Token Liquidity Velocity
kpis.business_definition: Traded quantity divided by total_sold per token. Measures turnover rate.
example_questions: What is the trading velocity for each token?
Token turnover rate
How fast are tokens turning over?
Liquidity velocity by token
quality_notes: Filter: lower(transactions.status) = 'completed'. Join transactions to tokens on token_id.

kpis.name: Token Holders Count
kpis.business_definition: Distinct holders per token (users with quantity > 0). Powers ATHLScan holders view and most-holders leaderboard.
example_questions: How many holders does each token have?
Which tokens have the most holders?
Token holder count
Number of unique holders per token
quality_notes: Filter quantity > 0. Use COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) per token_id.

kpis.name: Token Holder Distribution
kpis.business_definition: Distribution of holdings within a token across holders.
example_questions: How are token holdings distributed among holders?
Holder distribution for a token
Show me the holding breakdown per wallet
quality_notes: Filter quantity > 0.

kpis.name: Wallet Concentration Ratio
kpis.business_definition: Share of holdings held by top wallets per token — whale concentration detection.

sql_recipe.raw_sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT token_id, user_id, quantity, SUM(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY token_id) AS total_qty, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY token_id ORDER BY quantity DESC) AS rnk FROM user_token_wallet WHERE quantity > 0) SELECT token_id, SUM(CASE WHEN rnk <= 5 THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(MAX(total_qty), 0) AS top5_concentration FROM ranked GROUP BY token_id

example_questions: What is the wallet concentration for each token?
Are any tokens dominated by whale wallets?
Top 5 holder concentration ratio
quality_notes: Default: top 5 holders. Adjust N as needed.

kpis.name: Top Tokens Share of Volume
kpis.business_definition: Share of total transaction volume held by the top-N tokens. Volume concentration risk metric.

sql_recipe.raw_sql: WITH token_vol AS (SELECT token_id, SUM(total_amount_usdc) AS vol FROM transactions WHERE lower(status)='completed' GROUP BY token_id), total AS (SELECT SUM(vol) AS grand_total FROM token_vol) SELECT t.token_id, t.vol / NULLIF(tt.grand_total, 0) AS share FROM token_vol t CROSS JOIN total tt ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10

example_questions: What share of volume do the top 10 tokens account for?
Volume concentration across tokens
Top tokens by share of total volume
quality_notes: Filter: lower(transactions.status) = 'completed'.

kpis.name: Top Tokens by Volume
kpis.business_definition: Token ranking by traded volume or transaction count in a time window. Leaderboard guardrail: only matches ranking-style questions.

sql_recipe.raw_sql: SELECT t.token_id, tk.token_symbol, SUM(t.total_amount_usdc) AS volume, COUNT(t.transaction_id) AS trade_count FROM transactions t JOIN tokens tk ON t.token_id = tk.token_id WHERE lower(t.status)='completed' GROUP BY t.token_id, tk.token_symbol ORDER BY volume DESC LIMIT 10

example_questions: What are the top 10 tokens by trading volume this week?
Which tokens have the highest trading volume?
Token leaderboard by volume
Most traded tokens this month
Rank tokens by volume
quality_notes: Leaderboard guardrail: only matches ranking-intent questions (top, most, rank, highest).
Filter: lower(transactions.status) = 'completed'.

kpis.name: Buy vs Sell Ratio
kpis.business_definition: Ratio of buy-side to sell-side transaction activity. Degenerate on current data — all transactions are primary sales.
example_questions: What is the buy to sell ratio?
Ratio of buys to sells
Buy side vs sell side activity
quality_notes: All transactions are transaction_type='primary' in current data — secondary market does not exist yet.

kpis.name: Secondary Market Share
kpis.business_definition: Share of volume from secondary (peer-to-peer) trading. Currently 0% — no secondary trading exists.

sql_recipe.numerator: SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'secondary' THEN total_amount_usdc ELSE 0 END)

example_questions: What percentage of volume is from secondary trading?
Secondary market share of volume
How much of trading is peer to peer?
quality_notes: Returns 0% on current data — all transactions are primary. Correct degenerate result.

kpis.name: Failed or Reversed Transactions
kpis.business_definition: Count of failed or reversed transactions. Currently 0 — none generated in current data.

sql_recipe.numerator: COUNT(CASE WHEN lower(status) IN ('failed', 'reversed') THEN 1 END)

example_questions: How many transactions failed or were reversed?
Failed transaction count
Reversed transaction rate
quality_notes: Returns 0 on current data — no failed/reversed transactions generated.

kpis.name: Net New Users
kpis.business_definition: New registered users by time grain, using users.created_at.
example_questions: How many new users signed up this week?
New user registrations per day
User acquisition this month
New signups by country

kpis.name: Total Registered Users
kpis.business_definition: Total count of all registered users.
example_questions: How many total registered users do we have?
Total user count
How many users are on the platform?

kpis.name: User Growth Rate
kpis.business_definition: Period-over-period growth in registered users.

sql_recipe.raw_sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS month, COUNT(user_id) AS new_users FROM users GROUP BY 1) SELECT month, new_users, LAG(new_users) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_users, (new_users - LAG(new_users) OVER (ORDER BY month))::float / NULLIF(LAG(new_users) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0) AS growth_rate FROM monthly

example_questions: What is the month over month user growth rate?
How fast is user base growing?
User growth rate this month vs last month
quality_notes: Use LAG window function for period-over-period comparison.

kpis.name: Active Traders
kpis.business_definition: Distinct users who completed a transaction in the period (buyer_id only). MAT = month grain. seller_id excluded — equals issuer user_id on all primary sales.
example_questions: How many active traders did we have this month?
Monthly active traders
Distinct buyers this week
How many users traded this month?
quality_notes: Use buyer_id only. Including seller_id would inflate count since sellers = issuers on all primary sales.
Filter: lower(transactions.status) = 'completed'.

kpis.name: Active Sellers
kpis.business_definition: Distinct sellers in the period. In current data, sellers = issuers (all transactions are primary sales).
example_questions: How many active sellers are there?
Distinct sellers this month
Number of issuers selling tokens
quality_notes: In current data, seller_id = issuer's user_id on every primary sale.

kpis.name: Buyer to Seller Ratio
kpis.business_definition: Ratio of distinct active buyers to distinct active sellers in a period.
example_questions: What is the ratio of buyers to sellers?
How many buyers per seller?
Buyer seller ratio this month
quality_notes: Confounded until secondary trading — sellers are issuers in current data.

kpis.name: Repeat Buyer Rate
kpis.business_definition: Share of buyers who made more than one completed transaction.

sql_recipe.raw_sql: WITH buyer_counts AS (SELECT buyer_id, COUNT(transaction_id) AS tx_count FROM transactions WHERE lower(status)='completed' GROUP BY buyer_id) SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN tx_count > 1 THEN 1 END)::float / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS repeat_buyer_rate FROM buyer_counts

example_questions: What percentage of buyers made more than one purchase?
Repeat buyer rate
How many buyers purchased more than once?
quality_notes: Requires subquery: GROUP BY buyer_id, HAVING COUNT > 1.

kpis.name: Multi-Token Ownership Rate
kpis.business_definition: Share of token holders who hold more than one distinct token.

sql_recipe.raw_sql: WITH holder_counts AS (SELECT user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT token_id) AS token_count FROM user_token_wallet WHERE quantity > 0 GROUP BY user_id) SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN token_count > 1 THEN 1 END)::float / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS multi_token_rate FROM holder_counts

example_questions: What share of users hold more than one token?
Multi-token ownership rate
How many users own multiple tokens?
quality_notes: Filter quantity > 0.

kpis.name: Average Wallet Balance
kpis.business_definition: Average USDC wallet balance per user. usdc_balance is cost-basis, not mark-to-market.
example_questions: What is the average wallet balance?

sql_recipe.numerator: COUNT(CASE WHEN mfa_enabled = true THEN 1 END)

example_questions: What is the MFA adoption rate?

sql_recipe.numerator: COUNT(identity_check_id) FILTER (WHERE identity_verification.completed_at IS NOT NULL)

kpis.name: Issuer Activation Rate
kpis.business_definition: Issuers with a live token and at least one completed sale divided by all issuers. Old waitlist definition is retired.

sql_recipe.raw_sql: WITH active_issuers AS (SELECT DISTINCT i.issuer_id FROM issuers i JOIN tokens tk ON i.issuer_id = tk.issuer_id JOIN transactions tx ON tk.token_id = tx.token_id WHERE lower(tx.status)='completed') SELECT COUNT(ai.issuer_id)::float / NULLIF(COUNT(i.issuer_id), 0) AS activation_rate FROM issuers i LEFT JOIN active_issuers ai ON i.issuer_id = ai.issuer_id

example_questions: What share of issuers have made at least one sale?
Issuer activation rate
How many issuers have active tokens with sales?
quality_notes: Definition: issuer has at least one token with at least one completed transaction. Old waitlist definition is retired.

kpis.name: Token Launch Success Rate
kpis.business_definition: Issuers with a live token (paused_sales = false) divided by issuers who created any token record.

sql_recipe.raw_sql: WITH issuer_tokens AS (SELECT issuer_id, bool_or(paused_sales = false) AS has_live_token FROM tokens GROUP BY issuer_id) SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN it.has_live_token THEN 1 END)::float / NULLIF(COUNT(i.issuer_id), 0) AS launch_success_rate FROM issuers i LEFT JOIN issuer_tokens it ON i.issuer_id = it.issuer_id WHERE it.issuer_id IS NOT NULL

example_questions: What is the token launch success rate?
How many issuers successfully launched a token?
Token launch rate by issuer type
quality_notes: Denominator: issuers with at least one token record. Numerator: those with paused_sales=false.

kpis.name: Issuer Revenue
kpis.business_definition: Revenue per issuer, net of the platform take (~80% of gross). Source: issuer_daily_revenue.total_amount_usdc. FK issuer_daily_revenue.issuer_id -> issuers.issuer_id is clean.
example_questions: How much did each issuer earn?
Issuer revenue this month
Per-issuer earnings
Creator revenue breakdown
Athlete earnings
quality_notes: issuer_daily_revenue.total_amount_usdc is net (~80% of gross). Not the same as gross token revenue.
FK: issuer_daily_revenue.issuer_id -> issuers.issuer_id (clean join, no trap).

kpis.name: Average Revenue Per Issuer
kpis.business_definition: Mean issuer net revenue across all issuers.

sql_recipe.raw_sql: WITH per_issuer AS (SELECT issuer_id, SUM(total_amount_usdc) AS rev FROM issuer_daily_revenue GROUP BY issuer_id) SELECT AVG(rev) AS avg_revenue_per_issuer FROM per_issuer

example_questions: What is the average revenue per issuer?
Average earnings per athlete
Mean issuer revenue this month
quality_notes: Two-stage aggregation: sum per issuer, then average across issuers.

kpis.name: Top Issuer Revenue Share
kpis.business_definition: Share of total issuer net revenue held by the top-N issuers.

sql_recipe.raw_sql: WITH issuer_rev AS (SELECT issuer_id, SUM(total_amount_usdc) AS rev FROM issuer_daily_revenue GROUP BY issuer_id), total AS (SELECT SUM(rev) AS grand_total FROM issuer_rev) SELECT i.issuer_id, i.rev, i.rev / NULLIF(t.grand_total, 0) AS revenue_share FROM issuer_rev i CROSS JOIN total t ORDER BY i.rev DESC LIMIT 10

example_questions: What share of revenue do the top 10 issuers generate?
Revenue concentration among top issuers
Top issuer revenue share
quality_notes: issuer_daily_revenue is net (80%).

kpis.name: Issuer Revenue Growth
kpis.business_definition: Period-over-period growth in issuer net revenue.

sql_recipe.raw_sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT issuer_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', date) AS month, SUM(total_amount_usdc) AS rev FROM issuer_daily_revenue GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT issuer_id, month, rev, LAG(rev) OVER (PARTITION BY issuer_id ORDER BY month) AS prev_rev, (rev - LAG(rev) OVER (PARTITION BY issuer_id ORDER BY month)) / NULLIF(LAG(rev) OVER (PARTITION BY issuer_id ORDER BY month), 0) AS growth_rate FROM monthly

example_questions: What is the month over month issuer revenue growth?
Issuer revenue growth rate
Which issuers are growing fastest?
quality_notes: Use LAG window function partitioned by issuer_id.

kpis.name: Zero Revenue Issuers
kpis.business_definition: Count and share of issuers with no revenue in issuer_daily_revenue.
kpis.multi_table_rationale: Anti-join: issuers LEFT JOIN issuer_daily_revenue to find issuers with no revenue records.

sql_recipe.raw_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.issuer_id) AS zero_revenue_issuers FROM issuers i LEFT JOIN issuer_daily_revenue r ON i.issuer_id = r.issuer_id WHERE r.issuer_id IS NULL OR r.total_amount_usdc = 0

Issuers with no earnings
Count of issuers with no sales

sql_recipe.raw_sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', timestamp) AS month, SUM(total_amount_usdc) AS rev FROM transactions WHERE lower(status)='completed' GROUP BY 1) SELECT month, rev, LAG(rev) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_rev, (rev - LAG(rev) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / NULLIF(LAG(rev) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0) AS growth_rate FROM monthly

kpis.name: Revenue Concentration
kpis.business_definition: Share of platform issuer net revenue from the top-N issuers. Concentration risk metric.

sql_recipe.raw_sql: WITH rev AS (SELECT issuer_id, SUM(total_amount_usdc) AS rev FROM issuer_daily_revenue GROUP BY issuer_id ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 5), total AS (SELECT SUM(total_amount_usdc) AS grand_total FROM issuer_daily_revenue) SELECT SUM(r.rev) / NULLIF(t.grand_total, 0) AS top5_revenue_share FROM rev r CROSS JOIN total t

kpis.name: Platform Fee Revenue (synthetic)
kpis.business_definition: Platform take = gross token revenue minus issuer net revenue (~0.2 x gross). SYNTHETIC until a real fee ledger exists.
kpis.multi_table_rationale: Aggregate difference of two table totals (gross minus issuer net). Not a row-level join.

sql_recipe.raw_sql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(total_amount_usdc) FROM transactions WHERE lower(status)='completed') - (SELECT SUM(total_amount_usdc) FROM issuer_daily_revenue) AS platform_fee_revenue

example_questions: What is the platform fee revenue?
How much does the platform earn in fees?
Platform take rate revenue
What does the platform make?
quality_notes: SYNTHETIC: the 20% take is a generator constant, not a modeled fee. Flag this in output.
Derive as a difference so it stays correct if the generator ratio changes.
Do NOT match bare 'revenue' — that maps to total_token_revenue.

kpis.name: High Risk Wallet Concentration
kpis.business_definition: Tokens where the top wallet holds more than 50% of circulating supply — concentration risk heuristic.

sql_recipe.raw_sql: WITH holder AS (SELECT token_id, user_id, quantity, SUM(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY token_id) AS total FROM user_token_wallet WHERE quantity > 0) SELECT token_id, MAX(quantity) / NULLIF(MAX(total), 0) AS top_holder_share FROM holder GROUP BY token_id HAVING MAX(quantity) / NULLIF(MAX(total), 0) > 0.5

kpis.name: Country Distribution
kpis.business_definition: Geographic distribution of users and issuers by country. Compliance view.
kpis.multi_table_rationale: Two separate count queries on users and issuers by country — UNION ALL, no row-level join.

sql_recipe.raw_sql: SELECT 'user' AS entity_type, country, COUNT(user_id) AS count FROM users GROUP BY country UNION ALL SELECT 'issuer' AS entity_type, country, COUNT(issuer_id) AS count FROM issuers GROUP BY country ORDER BY entity_type, count DESC
